s: na Ya niSAne । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (svA॰uBa॰-saka॰-aniw .) niSAnamiti Syate rUpam । SAna Ya teje ityasya nityasanantatvAt । anekArTatvAt niSAnamiha tIkzRIkaraRam । na Ya, Sinoti Sinute KaqgaM karmmakAraH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: tejane BvA॰ uBa॰ saka॰ aniw । Sinoti Sinute aSEzIt aSezwa ।
m: 1. शि (accord. to some = √ शो) cl. 3. P. शिशाति (Impv. शिशीहि, शाधि), to grant, bestow, RV. (cf. Nir. v, 23); to present or satisfy with (instr.), ib.; cl. 5. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxvii, 3) शिनोति, शिनुते (p. शिषाय, शिष्ये; aor. अशैषीत्, अशेष्ट fut. शेष्यति, ˚ते), to sharpen.
2. शि m. N. of Śiva, W.
3. शि (in gram.) a technical term for the case-ending इ (substituted for जस् and शस् in neuters).
a: शि — {c5c} U. शिनोति, शिनुते 1 To whet, sharpen, --2 To attenuate, make thin. --3 To excite. --4 To be attentive. --5 To be sharp.

शिः — 1 Auspiciousness, good fortune. --2 Composure, calm, tranquillity, peace. --3 An {{eptihet->epithet||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}} of Śiva.
